rootCause: RobotCardTemplate had presentation-layer fallback logic for Gosha quotes, so non-KettyBot cards reused one generic quote instead of explicit per-slug copy.

Batch gallery generation trusted reduced robots.generated.json fallback. That data starts with square catalog/Hero media and omits converted source-gallery runtime assets, so previews could pass with missing/incorrect galleries.
Hard-coded gallery slicing split first five photos into the first gallery and left the second gallery thin when the robot had fewer assets.
Validation checked presence of H1/seoIntent/capability images but did not prove gallery runtime source, balanced split, vertical-first mobile affordance, or unique Gosha text.
